data.one_liner: A bottom navigation bar with convex shapes, animations, badges, and custom styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar widget featuring convex-shaped tabs and action buttons. It supports multiple built-in transition styles, custom badge overlays, and hooks to tweak internal dimensions and text styling. Developers can integrate it directly into Scaffold's bottomNavigationBar property or build custom layouts using builder delegates.
use_when: You want a bottom navigation bar with a raised, convex floating center tab or action button.
You need built-in tab styles like fixedCircle, reactCircle, or titled with integrated animations.
You want easy badge overlays on tab icons without manually wrapping each item.
avoid_when: You only require a standard Material 3 NavigationBar or CupertinoTabBar.
Your design calls for a notch-in FAB rather than a convex protruding shape.
strengths: Rich collection of built-in animation and tab styles (fixed, react, flip, textIn).
Convenient badge support via ConvexAppBar.badge for displaying counts or icons on tabs.
Customizable through ConvexAppBar.builder and style hooks for low-level overrides.
weaknesses: Style hooks can cause layout overflow if custom sizes conflict with internal calculations.
Infrequent maintenance updates relative to modern Flutter releases.
data.minimal_example:
ConvexAppBar(
  items: [
    TabItem(icon: Icons.home, title: 'Home'),
    TabItem(icon: Icons.map, title: 'Discovery'),
    TabItem(icon: Icons.add, title: 'Add'),
    TabItem(icon: Icons.message, title: 'Message'),
    TabItem(icon: Icons.people, title: 'Profile'),
  ],
  onTap: (int i) => print('click index=$i'),
)
